notes: Fix: the Smoke Mine now shows its icon in the gadget wheel and the HUD. Smoke grenades: the cloud is 10% bigger, and so is the area that counts as smoke. The Smoke Mine in the spy's jammer slot (3 charges) is a silent trap that pops a smoke cloud when a merc walks within 1.5 m of it, armed 2 s after it lands; untripped, it disappears after 45 s. Everyone in a match needs this build.

addons.title: Smoke grenade buff and smoke mines
